# Omnirexis

> UK consultancy setting up practical AI and connected systems for fitness and leisure businesses. Omnirexis gives fitness and leisure businesses their time back. Every enquiry answered, every lead followed up, every booking made, so you can focus on your clients while your business keeps growing.

Slogan: Intelligence. Automated.
Founder: Ross Gallagher (more than fifteen years in fitness and operational management).
Legal: Omnirexis is the trading name of Ross Gallagher, a sole trader. Not registered for VAT.
Who it is for: independent studio, gym, spa and leisure club owners and managers, and personal trainers, across the UK.
Service area: United Kingdom.

## Services
- [Solutions](https://www.omnirexis.co.uk/solutions): enquiry follow-up (phone, web form and email enquiries logged and chased, optional chat assistant), process automation, AI opportunity audit, approved-knowledge assistants. Scoped and priced after a free 30 minute Zoom strategy call.
- [Gyms](https://www.omnirexis.co.uk/gyms), [Pilates and yoga studios](https://www.omnirexis.co.uk/pilates-yoga-studios), [Leisure clubs and spas](https://www.omnirexis.co.uk/leisure)
- [Lead follow-up automation](https://www.omnirexis.co.uk/lead-follow-up-automation)
- [Rapid services](https://www.omnirexis.co.uk/rapid-services): Content Sprint £79, Operations Document Sprint £149, Content Engine £349 a month.

## Omnirexis PT
- [PT platform](https://www.omnirexis.co.uk/pt): live for self-serve signup. Free £0 (2 clients, a free plan, not a trial), Founding £14.99, Solo £17.99, Pro £24.99 a month.
